title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
content: Covers crop failure and localized natural disasters. Farmer premium rates are fixed at 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for commercial or horticultural crops. Farmers must report localized calamities such as hailstorms within a mandatory 72-hour window to remain eligible for a claim.
source: Dept. of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, PMFBY Operational Guidelines (pmfby.gov.in)

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
content: Direct income support scheme providing eligible farmer families ₹6,000 per year, paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000. Eligibility is based on landholding, requires Aadhaar e-KYC, and excludes institutional landholders, income tax payers, and constitutional post holders.
source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, PM-KISAN Operational Guidelines

title: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
content: Provides financial assistance and subsidies ranging from 40% to 50% for farmers to purchase farm equipment such as power tillers, tractors, and sprayers, or to establish village-level Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs).
source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, SMAM Guidelines
